Subject: Re: Fwd: Oct 21 webinar — final platform checklist and recording consent

Thanks Grace. Draft ops checklist below — I’ll own event-side coordination and registration copy. Ben, can you confirm streaming/RTMP details and whether we need an ON24-engineered bridge? Dylan, please coordinate the passcode and test recordings.

Ops dry-run checklist (high level):
1) Account access: ON24 admin & Zoom Events host added (confirm logins)
2) Streaming topology: ON24 session as canonical stream, Zoom RTMP configured as backup to ON24 ingest; test failover
3) Recording policy: record to partner S3 with retention 90 days by default; vendor signing for S3 write access needed
4) Consent capture: Add explicit checkbox to registration: "I consent to speakers and Redwood/MarketingLabs storing and sharing the recording for event-related follow-up." Link to privacy note required
5) Speaker consent: run a 5-min pre-record/consent step during dry run and capture verbal consent + checklist entry
6) Passcode & gating: optional passcode for panelist area; public registration page uses company-size field to gate resources
7) Test artifacts: perform 10-min recording, download, verify audio/video A/V sync, verify captions and embed code
8) Escalation: contact list for ON24 & Zoom support and Redwood infra ops (Ben)

I attached a short stream test plan and a screenshot of Zoom settings I usually use. Will update timeline after Ben confirms technical pieces.

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Events Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: stream-test-plan.pdf (application/pdf); zoom-settings.png (image/png)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Kahn <samira@marketinglabs.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 14:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Oct 21 webinar — final platform checklist and recording consent

Short technical notes:
- ON24: we can run as canonical. Their ingest endpoint accepts RTMP from Zoom as a fallback; we will run a simultaneous RTMP to ON24 ingest in the dry run and test failover by cutting the ON24 ingest to validate continuous playback.
- Zoom RTMP: Zoom Events host must enable live streaming and RTMP key for target ON24 ingest URL; I’ve documented the required fields in the attached plan.
- Recording flow: Redwood can push the recording to MarketingLabs S3 via presigned PUT, but we need a signed agreement for write access and an S3 bucket policy. Alternative: Redwood stores canonical recording and shares a time-limited link to MarketingLabs.
- Speaker consent: we should include a one-click checkbox in the registration and capture a timestamped log entry in the registration artifact; I can add a small event that records consent metadata to the event record.

I recommend the dry run on Tue Oct 14 12:00 PT as proposed. I’ll be on the call and will run the stream switch and download verification.

Ben
Platform Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
